'''Aluminium''' or '''aluminum''' was a malleable and ductile metal. It was also an excellent heat and electricity conductor, a light material and a good corrosion-resistant material. It was the basic element for forming [[Agrinium]], which was applied to [[Droid/Legends|droid]] armor.

Aluminium, along with [[Sodium/Legends|sodium]] and [[Magnesium/Legends|magnesium]], comprised the majority of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Columus/Legends|Columus]]' core.<ref name="GG4-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>
